# Signal design library: guide for AI agents

Read this before writing UI with Signal (`signal-design`). It is the contract:
what to install, the rules the design holds to, the parts to build from, and
how to check your work. The full component reference, with copyable HTML for
every part, is in `llms-full.txt` and `ai/components.json`.

## What it is

A flat, square, monochrome design library: CSS components (`sd-` classes) on
Tailwind CSS v4 or as one prebuilt stylesheet, plus a small dependency-free JS
module that wires behavior through attributes. Optional charts on Chart.js.
It runs in browsers and in Tauri (WebView2, WKWebView, WebKitGTK).

## Install (from GitHub, not npm)

```bash
pnpm add github:Medalink/signal-design        # or: npm install github:Medalink/signal-design
pnpm add github:Medalink/signal-design#v0.1.0 # pin a tag or commit for reproducible builds
```

**With Tailwind v4** (no build step needed for Signal itself):

```css
/* app.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "signal-design";
```

**Without Tailwind**: link `dist/signal.css` and keep `dist/fonts/` next to it.
`dist/` is built by the package's `prepare` script on a git install. If
`node_modules/signal-design/dist/` is missing, allow the script and reinstall
(npm: `npm approve-scripts signal-design`; pnpm: add `signal-design` to
`onlyBuiltDependencies`). Each GitHub Release
also has `signal-design-dist.zip` with `signal.css`, `signal.js` and the fonts.

**JS** (optional, but anything with a `data-sd-*` attribute needs it):

```js
import { init } from "signal-design/js";
init(); // once, after the DOM exists; every listener is delegated, so later markup works too
```

**Charts** (optional): `pnpm add chart.js@^4.5`, then `import { createChart } from "signal-design/charts"`.

## Hard rules (do not break these)

1. **Square corners.** No `rounded-*`, no `border-radius`. Avatars and checkboxes too.
2. **Flat.** No blurred `box-shadow`, no glow, no glass, no CSS gradients. Hairlines only.
3. **Color means something.** Only status and focus are colored, via the roles
   `accent`, `success`, `danger`, `warning`, `pending`, `extra` (`data-tone="danger"`,
   `text-danger`). Everything else, navigation included, is black, white and grey.
   Never use hues directly (`text-pink`, `#ff3366`).
4. **Tokens, not values.** Colors come from `--sd-*` variables or the Tailwind
   utilities built on them (`bg-canvas`, `bg-surface`, `text-fg-muted`, `border-line`).
   Never hard-code a hex value; themes would break.
5. **Two faces.** SF Pro (the system UI font; Segoe UI on Windows) in regular and medium for text,
   Source Code Pro (bundled) for code. No other families or weights.
6. **Motion on state change only.** 120–200ms transitions. Nothing loops for decoration.
7. **Style state, not classes.** The JS writes ARIA and `data-*` (`aria-pressed`,
   `aria-expanded`, `aria-current`, `aria-selected`, `data-open`, `data-tone`);
   the CSS keys on those. Set the same attributes from your own code to drive state.

## Themes

`<html data-theme="ink">` (default, near-black) · `graphite` (lighter dark) ·
`paper` (white; `light` is an older alias) · `auto` (ink, or paper when the OS
asks for light). `setTheme("paper")` switches and remembers; Shift+T cycles.
Any element can carry `data-theme` to theme a subtree. Charts add
`data-chart-theme="mono"` (default, greys) or `"spectrum"` (full palette).

## Building pages

Start from the closest pattern; copy its HTML from `ai/components.json` (search
by `title` or `classes`) rather than inventing markup.

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Reading page | `<main class="sd-page">` (720px column) or `sd-page sd-page-wide` |
| App with navigation | Signal App Shell: `sd-shell` > `sd-rail`, `sd-sidebar`, `sd-shell-main` (`sd-shell-header` or `sd-shell-bar`, `sd-shell-content`, optional `sd-shell-dock`), `sd-shell-aside`, `sd-statusbar sd-shell-status` |
| Desktop window chrome | `sd-titlebar` with `sd-window-controls` (`data-sd-window`) |
| Buttons | `sd-btn` + `sd-btn-primary` (one per view) / `sd-btn-ghost` / `sd-btn-link`, sizes `-sm` `-lg` `-icon` `-block` |
| Forms | `sd-field` > `sd-field-label` + control + `sd-field-hint`; inputs are styled unclassed |
| Choices | `sd-seg` (segmented), `role="switch"` checkbox, `sd-combobox`, `sd-tags`, `sd-number` |
| Overlays | `<dialog class="sd-dialog">` + `data-sd-open`; `popover` + `.sd-popover`; `data-sd-tip`; `toast()` |
| Lists and rows | `sd-item`, `sd-row`, `sd-table`, `sd-kv` |
| Status | `sd-badge`, `sd-status`, `sd-dot`, `sd-count`, `sd-progress`, `sd-checks` |
| Chat and feeds | `sd-message`, `sd-composer`, `sd-reactions`, `sd-banner`, `sd-file` |
| Data | `sd-stat`, `sd-stat-box`, `createChart(canvas, { type })`, `sd-plot`, `sd-heatmap`, `sd-uptime`, `sd-meter` |
| Empty | `sd-empty` (gets a center ornament automatically) |

Tone anything with `data-tone`. Mark the current location with `aria-current`.
Use `sd-desktop-only` / `sd-phone-only` (split at 768px) for chrome that changes on phones.

## Accessibility (your part)

The library meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and wires keyboard behavior. You still must:
- give every icon-only control an `aria-label`;
- have one `<h1>` per page (use `class="sd-sr-only"` if it should not show);
- start the page with `<a class="sd-skip" href="#main">Skip to content</a>` and give
  the target `id="main" tabindex="-1"`;
- label a desktop title bar: `role="region" aria-label="Window"`;
- keep focus visible (do not remove outlines);
- respect `prefers-reduced-motion` in any motion you add.

## Check your work

```bash
npx signal-design check http://localhost:5173/          # your running app
npx signal-design check http://localhost:5173/ --a11y   # plus an axe WCAG 2.2 AA audit
```

It loads each URL in Chromium (Playwright) and fails on: rounded corners,
blurred shadows, CSS gradients, horizontal overflow at 1280/768/375px, fonts
that did not load, console errors, and (with `--a11y`) accessibility
violations. Needs `playwright` (and `axe-core` for `--a11y`) installed, and
`npx playwright install chromium` once.

## Files for tools

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `ai/components.json` | Every block: id, section, title, classes, `data-sd-*` attributes, copyable HTML, required JS, a JS snippet where one applies |
| `ai/tokens.json` | Every token resolved per theme (W3C design-token form), with contrast ratios |
| `llms-full.txt` | This guide plus every component's HTML, as one text file |
| `vscode/html-data.json`, `vscode/css-data.json` | Editor completions for `data-sd-*` and `--sd-*` |
| `src/js/index.d.ts`, `src/js/charts/index.d.ts` | Types for the JS API |
| `README.md` | Human documentation |

## Common mistakes

- Adding `rounded`, `shadow-lg` or `bg-gradient-*` from Tailwind habit. Remove them.
- Coloring navigation, headings or icons. Keep them grey; color is for status.
- Writing `color: #...` or `bg-[#...]`. Use a role token.
- Forgetting `init()`, so `data-sd-*` attributes do nothing.
- Building a custom dropdown, tooltip, modal or tabs. Use the native element plus Signal.
- Wrapping the app in your own sidebar layout instead of `sd-shell`.

---

# Component reference (generated)

Every block from the components page, with its copyable HTML. `JS:` says what `init()` must wire.

## Tokens / Hard rules



Classes: none

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<ol class="grid gap-y-2 gap-x-16 sm:grid-cols-2 text-fg-muted" style="list-style: decimal-leading-zero; padding-inline-start: 2.2em">
  <li>Square corners everywhere, avatars and checkboxes included.</li>
  <li>Flat surfaces. No glass, grain, glow or shadow. Fades are for borders and edges only.</li>
  <li>Color is for important things: risk, status, success, focus. Everything else is black, white and grey, navigation included.</li>
  <li>Motion on state change only: 120–200ms transitions and a one-pass hover shimmer. The rain moves only while work runs.</li>
  <li>Minimal by default, detail on expand.</li>
  <li>SF Pro for text in regular and medium; Source Code Pro for code.</li>
</ol>
```

## Tokens / Semantic roles



Classes: none

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4" data-swatches="roles"></div>
```

## Tokens / Signals

The only saturated colors. Each one has a job. Use the role (text-danger), not the hue (text-pink), so paper (the light theme) can deepen it.

Classes: none

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4" data-swatches="signals"></div>
```

## Tokens / Greys

Ink is the shipped Signal ramp: cool and near-black. Graphite is the original ramp from the spec table. The ink theme uses the first, the graphite theme the second.

Classes: none

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="grid grid-cols-[repeat(13,minmax(0,1fr))] gap-1" data-swatches="ink"></div>

<div class="grid grid-cols-[repeat(13,minmax(0,1fr))] gap-1" data-swatches="graphite"></div>
```

## Tokens / Spec vs shipped

The original spec table and the shipped stylesheet disagree. Ink, the shipped ramp, is the canonical default. Graphite keeps the spec values as an optional theme.

Classes: sd-table, sd-table-wrap

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="sd-table-wrap">
  <table class="sd-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Role</th><th>Ink (default)</th><th>Graphite (spec)</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><th scope="row">Canvas</th><td><span class="inline-block size-3 align-middle mr-2 border border-line" style="background:#000000"></span>#000000</td><td><span class="inline-block size-3 align-middle mr-2 border border-line" style="background:#0F0F0F"></span>#0F0F0F</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Surface / raised</th><td>#0A0A0A / #191A1D</td><td>#0A0A0A / #151515</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Text</th><td>#F1F3F7 · #D4D4D4 · #A3A3A3 · #737373</td><td>#E5E5E5 · #A3A3A3 · #6B6B6B</td></tr>
      <tr><th scope="row">Lines</th><td>white 8% / 16% (alpha)</td><td>#2E2E2E / #3D3D3D (solid)</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
```

## Tokens / Contrast on canvas

WCAG ratio of each text role against the current canvas. Body text needs 4.5. fg-faint is for decoration, disabled states and large display text only.

Classes: sd-table, sd-table-compact, sd-table-wrap

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="sd-table-wrap"><table class="sd-table sd-table-compact" data-contrast=""></table></div>
```

## Tokens / Type scale



Classes: sd-table, sd-table-wrap

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="sd-table-wrap"><table class="sd-table" data-type-scale=""></table></div>
```

## Tokens / Tracking and weight



Classes: none

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="grid gap-3">
  <p class="text-3xl tracking-display">display −0.03em</p>
  <p class="text-lg tracking-tight">tight −0.025em for row titles</p>
  <p class="text-2xs uppercase tracking-caps text-fg-subtle">caps 0.14em · status line</p>
  <p class="text-2xs uppercase tracking-widest text-fg-subtle">widest 0.16em · labels</p>
  <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-wordmark font-semibold">wordmark 0.28em</p>
  <p class="text-lg"><span class="font-normal">400 regular</span> · <span class="font-semibold">500 medium</span></p>
</div>
```

## Tokens / Spacing, layout, motion



Classes: sd-btn, sd-dot, sd-kv, sd-row, sd-row-body, sd-row-title

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-3">
  <dl class="sd-kv">
    <dt>Base unit</dt><dd>4px (Tailwind <code>--spacing</code>)</dd>
    <dt>Column</dt><dd>720px <code>max-w-column</code></dd>
    <dt>Narrow</dt><dd>560px <code>max-w-narrow</code></dd>
    <dt>Wide</dt><dd>1024px <code>max-w-wide</code></dd>
  </dl>
  <dl class="sd-kv">
    <dt>Fast</dt><dd>120ms hover, color</dd>
    <dt>Base</dt><dd>160ms collapse, toast</dd>
    <dt>Slow</dt><dd>200ms expand, scroll</dd>
    <dt>Ease</dt><dd><code>ease-out</code></dd>
  </dl>
  <div class="grid gap-3 content-start">
    <button type="button" class="sd-btn" data-demo="motion">Replay slide-in</button>
    <div class="sd-row" data-demo-row="" style="min-height: 0; padding-block: 10px">
      <span class="sd-dot" data-tone="success"></span>
      <div class="sd-row-body"><p class="sd-row-title text-md">New item arrives in 180ms</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Elements / Text



Classes: none

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="max-w-[42rem]">
  <p>Paragraph text sits at 16px on a 1.5 line height. It holds a <a href="#elements">link</a>, <strong>strong</strong>, <em>emphasis</em>, <i>idiomatic</i>, <b>bold</b>, <small>small print</small>, <mark>marked</mark>, <del>deleted</del>, <ins>inserted</ins>, <s>struck</s>, <u>underlined</u>, H<sub>2</sub>O, x<sup>2</sup>, <abbr title="Continuous integration">CI</abbr>, <cite>a cited title</cite>, <q>an inline quote</q>, <dfn>a definition</dfn>, <time datetime="2026-10-18T07:55">07:55</time>, <var>count</var>, <samp>exit 0</samp>, <code>code()</code> and <kbd><kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>N</kbd></kbd>.</p>
  <p>A second paragraph follows with flow spacing. Margins only appear between siblings, never after the last one.</p>
  <address>ACME Inc. · 100 Main Street · Springfield</address>
</div>
```

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html

      </div>
```
```html
    </div>
```
```html
  </fieldset>

  <fieldset>

    <div class="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">

        <select>
          <optgroup label="Plans"><option>Starter</option><option selected="">Pro</option><option>Enterprise</option></optgroup>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="grid gap-1.5">multiple
        <select multiple="" size="4"><option selected="">Website</option><option>Mobile app</option><option selected="">Billing</option><option>Support</option></select>
      </label>
      <label class="grid gap-1.5">textarea <textarea placeholder="Leave a note"></textarea></label>
    </div>
  </fieldset>

  <fieldset>
    <legend>Output, progress, meter</legend>
    <div class="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <label class="grid gap-2">progress 64% <progress value="64" max="100"></progress></label>
      <label class="grid gap-2">progress indeterminate <progress></progress></label>
      <label class="grid gap-2">meter optimum <meter value="0.9" low="0.3" high="0.7" optimum="1"></meter></label>
      <label class="grid gap-2">meter suboptimum <meter value="0.5" low="0.3" high="0.7" optimum="1"></meter></label>
      <label class="grid gap-2">meter poor <meter value="0.1" low="0.3" high="0.7" optimum="1"></meter></label>
      <p>output: <output>214</output> tests</p>
    </div>
  </fieldset>

  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
    <input type="submit" value="Submit">
    <button>Button</button>
    <input type="reset" value="Reset">
    <button disabled="">Disabled</button>
```

## Elements / Details, dialog, popover



Classes: none

JS: init() from signal-design/js wires data-sd-open · data-sd-close · popovertarget (placement, menu keys).

```html
<div>
  <details open="">
    <summary>What happens when I approve?</summary>
    <p>The item moves to Done and the owner is notified.</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>What does Request changes do?</summary>
    <p>It asks for a note and sends it to the owner.</p>
  </details>
</div>

<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
  <button data-sd-open="plain-dialog">Open a plain &lt;dialog&gt;</button>
  <button popovertarget="plain-popover">Toggle a plain [popover]</button>
</div>

<dialog id="plain-dialog">
  <h4>Plain dialog</h4>
  <p>Unclassed, styled by the base layer. Click the backdrop or the button to close.</p>
  <button data-sd-close="">Close</button>
</dialog>

<div popover="" id="plain-popover"><p>Plain popover, centered by the browser.</p></div>
```

## Components / Text styles

sd-display + -xl (em or sd-quiet for the quiet half) · sd-title · sd-lead · sd-label + -strong · sd-muted|subtle|faint · sd-meta

Classes: sd-cluster, sd-display, sd-display-xl, sd-faint, sd-label, sd-label-strong, sd-lead, sd-meta, sd-muted, sd-quiet, sd-subtle, sd-title

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="grid gap-5">
  <p class="sd-display sd-display-xl">32 open. <em>8 done.</em></p>
  <p class="sd-display">Display line <span class="sd-quiet">with a quiet half.</span></p>
  <p class="sd-title">Title: a section or panel heading</p>
  <p class="sd-lead max-w-[42rem]">Lead: the paragraph under a page title, a step softer than body text.</p>
  <div class="sd-cluster" style="--gap: 20px"><span class="sd-label">Label</span><span class="sd-label sd-label-strong">Strong label</span><span class="sd-muted">muted</span><span class="sd-subtle">subtle</span><span class="sd-faint">faint</span></div>
  <p class="sd-meta"><span>Owner Jane</span><span>07:55</span><span data-tone="danger">risk</span></p>
</div>
```

## Components / Visibility helpers

sd-desktop-only · sd-phone-only · sd-sr-only (read by screen readers, not shown). Resize the window to see the first two swap.

Classes: sd-badge, sd-btn, sd-btn-icon, sd-cluster, sd-desktop-only, sd-phone-only, sd-sr-only

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html

  <span class="sd-badge sd-desktop-only">shown above 48rem</span>
  <span class="sd-badge sd-phone-only">shown on phones</span>
```

```html
</div>
```

## Components / Living tables

Drag the grip on the trailing edge, or focus it and use the arrow keys. Metadata folds beneath each title as the container narrows. Groups open independently. Width only. Arrow keys move 16px, Shift + arrows move 64px, Home fits the minimum, End fills the parent, and Escape cancels a drag. Requires CSS subgrid and container queries, supported in Chromium 117+ and Safari 16+. Call refresh() after changing rows or groups; remount for a different column schema. Without mounting, this is a readable static table.

Classes: sd-actions, sd-badge, sd-btn, sd-btn-ghost, sd-btn-sm, sd-living-table, sd-living-table-count, sd-living-table-group, sd-table, sd-table-wrap

JS: Call mountLivingTable(root) from signal-design/js; init() does not mount it. Call dispose() on teardown.

```html
<div class="sd-actions" id="living-table-widths" aria-label="Living table width previews">
  <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" type="button" data-living-width="360">Compact</button>
  <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" type="button" data-living-width="640">Comfortable</button>
  <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm sd-btn-ghost" type="button" data-living-width="fluid">Fill space</button>
</div>

<div class="sd-living-table" data-sd-living-table="" id="living-table-demo">
  <div class="sd-table-wrap" id="living-table-content">
    <table class="sd-table">
      <caption>Signal kit / Component work</caption>
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Work item</th><th scope="col" data-fold="2">Status</th><th scope="col" data-fold="2">Reference</th><th scope="col" data-fold="1">Owner</th><th scope="col" data-fold="1">Updated</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody data-id="review">
        <tr class="sd-living-table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="5"><button type="button" disabled="" aria-expanded="true">In review <span class="sd-living-table-count" aria-hidden="true">2</span></button></th></tr>
        <tr><th scope="row"><a href="#components-buttons">Tighten button focus rings</a></th><td><span class="sd-badge" data-tone="pending">Review</span></td><td><code>SGN-142</code></td><td>Mira Chen</td><td><time datetime="2026-10-19T14:20:00Z">12 min ago</time></td></tr>
        <tr><th scope="row">Document keyboard shortcuts</th><td><span class="sd-badge" data-tone="pending">Review</span></td><td><code>SGN-139</code></td><td>Jon Bell</td><td><time datetime="2026-10-19T13:32:00Z">1 hour ago</time></td></tr>
      </tbody>
      <tbody data-id="progress">
        <tr class="sd-living-table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="5"><button type="button" disabled="" aria-expanded="true">In progress <span class="sd-living-table-count" aria-hidden="true">2</span></button></th></tr>
        <tr><th scope="row">Keep chart labels readable</th><td><span class="sd-badge" data-tone="accent">Active</span></td><td><code>SGN-146</code></td><td>Ada Reed</td><td><time datetime="2026-10-19T12:32:00Z">2 hours ago</time></td></tr>

      </tbody>
      <tbody data-id="planned">
        <tr class="sd-living-table-group"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="5"><button type="button" disabled="" aria-expanded="true">Planned <span class="sd-living-table-count" aria-hidden="true">1</span></button></th></tr>
        <tr><th scope="row">Add empty state recipes</th><td><span class="sd-badge">Queued</span></td><td><code>SGN-151</code></td><td>Lea Park</td><td><time datetime="2026-10-18">Yesterday</time></td></tr>
      </tbody>

        <tr><th scope="row">Ship the paper theme</th><td><span class="sd-badge" data-tone="success">Done</span></td><td><code>SGN-128</code></td><td>Ravi Shah</td><td><time datetime="2026-10-17">2 days ago</time></td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <div data-sd-living-resize="" hidden="" role="separator" aria-label="Resize component work table" aria-orientation="vertical" aria-controls="living-table-content"></div>
</div>
```

```js
import { mountLivingTable } from "signal-design/js";

const root = document.getElementById("living-table-demo");
const table = mountLivingTable(root);
const preview = document.getElementById("living-table-widths");
for (const button of preview.querySelectorAll("[data-living-width]")) {
  button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const value = button.dataset.livingWidth;
    table.resize({ width: value === "fluid" ? null : Number(value) });
  });
}
```

## Conversation / Items, presence, counts



Classes: sd-avatar, sd-avatar-lg, sd-badge-count, sd-btn, sd-btn-icon, sd-cluster, sd-item, sd-item-body, sd-item-end, sd-item-group, sd-item-nested, sd-item-sub, sd-item-title

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 items-start">
  <div class="border border-line py-2" style="background: var(--sd-surface)">
    <div class="sd-item-group">Online <span>2</span></div>
    <a class="sd-item" href="#conversation" aria-current="true"><span class="sd-avatar" data-tone="extra" data-status="online">AL</span><span class="sd-item-body"><span class="sd-item-title">Alex</span><span class="sd-item-sub">Reviewing the spec</span></span><span class="sd-item-end">2m</span></a>
    <a class="sd-item" href="#conversation" data-unread=""><span class="sd-avatar" data-tone="warning" data-status="away">SK</span><span class="sd-item-body"><span class="sd-item-title">Sam</span><span class="sd-item-sub">Can you look at this?</span></span><span class="sd-item-end"><span class="sd-badge-count" data-tone="danger">2</span></span></a>
    <div class="sd-item-group">Offline <span>1</span></div>
    <a class="sd-item" href="#conversation" data-muted=""><span class="sd-avatar" data-tone="accent" data-status="offline">TP</span><span class="sd-item-body"><span class="sd-item-title">Taylor</span><span class="sd-item-sub">Muted</span></span></a>
    <a class="sd-item sd-item-nested" href="#conversation"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"><path d="M6 2.5 5 13.5M11 2.5l-1 11M2.5 6h11M2 10h11"></path></svg><span class="sd-item-body"><span class="sd-item-title">nested row</span></span></a>
  </div>
  <div class="grid gap-4 content-start">
    <div class="sd-cluster" style="--gap: 18px">
      <span class="sd-avatar sd-avatar-lg" data-tone="extra" data-status="online">AL</span>
      <span class="sd-avatar sd-avatar-lg" data-tone="warning" data-status="away">SK</span>

      <span class="sd-avatar sd-avatar-lg" data-tone="success" data-status="offline">JD</span>
      <span class="relative inline-grid"><button class="sd-btn sd-btn-icon" aria-label="Inbox, 3 unread">✉</button><span class="sd-badge-count" data-corner="">3</span></span>
      <span class="sd-badge-count" data-tone="danger">12</span>
    </div>
    <p class="demo-usage"><code>sd-item</code> + <code>-body|-title|-sub|-end|-group|-nested</code> · <code>data-unread</code> · <code>data-muted</code> · <code>data-status="online|away|busy|offline"</code> · <code>sd-badge-count</code> + <code>data-corner</code></p>
```

## Charts / Live time series

sd-chart + -bar|-plot · data-sd-chart-scale · createChart({ preset }) · data-chart-theme="mono|spectrum"

Classes: sd-chart, sd-chart-bar, sd-chart-plot, sd-label, sd-label-strong, sd-seg, sd-seg-inline, sd-seg-sm, sd-status

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<figure class="sd-chart" style="--h: 340px" id="demo-core">
  <div class="sd-chart-bar">
    <div><span class="sd-label sd-label-strong">Core</span><span class="sd-status" data-tone="success">live</span></div>
    <div class="sd-seg sd-seg-sm sd-seg-inline" data-sd-chart-scale="" aria-label="Scale">
      <button type="button" data-value="clamp">clamp</button><button type="button" data-value="p95">p95</button><button type="button" data-value="p90">p90</button><button type="button" data-value="linear">linear</button><button type="button" data-value="log">log</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sd-chart-plot"><canvas role="img" aria-label="Core bandwidth and round-trip time"></canvas></div>
</figure>
```

```js
import { createChart } from "signal-design/charts";

const core = createChart(document.querySelector("#demo-core canvas"), {
  preset: "core",                      // bandwidth over latency, one time axis
  bucketSeconds: 10, live: 2, envelope: 60,
  series: [
    { label: "Core ↓", data: down },   // [{ x: ms, y: Mbps }]
    { label: "Core ↑", data: up },
    { label: "Core → MDF RTT", unit: " ms", data: rtt, min: jitterLow, max: jitterHigh },
  ],
});
core.append({ "Core ↓": [{ x: Date.now(), y: 4200 }] });
```

## Charts / Chart types

createChart(canvas, { type }) · stacked · markers · series colors --sd-chart-1…6 or a tone. More in the chart gallery.

No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.

```html
<div class="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2">
  <figure class="sd-chart" style="--h: 220px" id="demo-line"><div class="sd-chart-bar"><span class="sd-label">type "line"</span></div><div class="sd-chart-plot"><canvas role="img" aria-label="Line chart"></canvas></div></figure>
  <figure class="sd-chart" style="--h: 220px" id="demo-bar"><div class="sd-chart-bar"><span class="sd-label">type "bar" · stacked</span></div><div class="sd-chart-plot"><canvas role="img" aria-label="Stacked bar chart"></canvas></div></figure>
  <figure class="sd-chart" style="--h: 220px" id="demo-hbar"><div class="sd-chart-bar"><span class="sd-label">type "hbar"</span></div><div class="sd-chart-plot"><canvas role="img" aria-label="Ranking"></canvas></div></figure>
  <figure class="sd-chart" style="--h: 220px" id="demo-hist"><div class="sd-chart-bar"><span class="sd-label">type "histogram"</span></div><div class="sd-chart-plot"><canvas role="img" aria-label="Histogram"></canvas></div></figure>
</div>
```

```js
import { createChart } from "signal-design/charts";

createChart(canvas, {
  type: "line",            // line | area | step | bar | hbar | histogram | scatter
  labels: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"],
  unit: " ms",
  series: [{ label: "p50", data: [82, 80, 91, 88, 79] }, { label: "p95", data: [190, 210, 260, 230, 200] }],
  markers: [{ axis: "y", value: 250, label: "SLO", tone: "warning" }],
});
```

```html
</div>
```

## Effects / Scrollbars

Hidden until something scrolls, hidden again 2s after it stops. Only the thumb color changes, so nothing shifts. init({ scrollbars: "always" }) keeps them.

## JS / Copy feedback

Copy needs browser clipboard access. On an insecure LAN connection, or when permission is denied, the danger toast says "Copy unavailable. Select the line instead." The command stays selectable. Successful copies still say "Copied". No insecure clipboard bypass is used.

Classes: sd-btn, sd-btn-ghost, sd-btn-sm, sd-code, sd-code-head

JS: init() from signal-design/js wires data-sd-copy.

```html
<div class="sd-code">
  <div class="sd-code-head">Command <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm sd-btn-ghost" data-sd-copy="#copy-command">Copy</button></div>
  <pre id="copy-command" tabindex="0"><code>npm test</code></pre>
</div>
```

## JS / Pauseable countdown

Call mountCountdown(root), then set({ remainingMs, running }) with authoritative time. init() does not mount it. Progress uses the largest remaining time since mount or the last completion. Remount for a different task; call dispose() on teardown. sd:countdown reports state changes, not every tick. The application owns eligibility and actions.

Classes: sd-actions, sd-btn, sd-btn-sm, sd-meta, sd-note, sd-progress, sd-stack

JS: Call mountCountdown(root) from signal-design/js, then set({ remainingMs, running }); init() does not mount it.

```html
<div class="sd-stack" id="demo-countdown" data-sd-countdown="" data-state="paused">
  <p class="sd-note" data-tone="pending">Next step in <span data-sd-countdown-value="">5</span>s.</p>
  <div class="sd-progress" role="progressbar" aria-label="Elapsed countdown time" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0" style="--value: 0"></div>
  <p class="sd-meta" id="countdown-state" role="status">paused</p>
</div>

<div class="sd-actions"><button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" id="countdown-resume">Resume</button><button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" id="countdown-pause">Pause</button><button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" id="countdown-resync">Resync to 5s</button></div>
```

```js
import { mountCountdown } from "signal-design/js";
const root = document.getElementById("demo-countdown");
const countdown = mountCountdown(root);
let remainingMs = 5000;
let startedAt = null;
root.addEventListener("sd:countdown", ({ detail }) => {
  document.getElementById("countdown-state").textContent = detail.state;
  if (detail.state === "complete") { remainingMs = 0; startedAt = null; }
});
function set(running) {
  if (startedAt !== null) remainingMs = Math.max(0, remainingMs - (performance.now() - startedAt));
  startedAt = running ? performance.now() : null;
  countdown.set({ remainingMs, running });
}
set(false);
document.getElementById("countdown-resume").onclick = () => set(true);
document.getElementById("countdown-pause").onclick = () => set(false);
document.getElementById("countdown-resync").onclick = () => {
  remainingMs = 5000;
  startedAt = null;
  set(false);
};
```

## JS / Live feed navigation

Focus the feed for j/k, g then t for newest, and n for oldest. Insert a row while reading to keep your place. Rows need stable data-id and numeric data-order. Call beforeUpdate() before replacing rows and afterUpdate() afterward. select(id) handles application targets. refresh() reconciles selection; suspend(true) cancels idle return and motion; dispose() removes listeners and timers. DOM order controls next/previous, numeric order controls oldest/newest.

Classes: sd-actions, sd-btn, sd-btn-sm, sd-expand, sd-note, sd-pill, sd-row, sd-row-body, sd-row-title, sd-stack

JS: Call mountFeed(root, options) and hotkeys(map, options) from signal-design/js; init() wires detail toggles.

```html
<div class="sd-stack">
  <div class="sd-actions"><button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" id="feed-insert">Insert row</button><button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" id="feed-oldest">Oldest</button><button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" id="feed-newest">Newest</button><span class="sd-pill" id="feed-above" role="status">0 above</span></div>
  <div class="sd-stack" id="demo-feed" data-sd-feed="" data-sd-scroll-tab="" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Activity feed" style="max-height: 14rem; overflow-y: auto">
    <article class="sd-row" data-id="activity-3" data-order="3"><div class="sd-row-body"><p class="sd-row-title">Build completed</p></div></article>
    <article class="sd-row" data-id="activity-2" data-order="2" aria-current="true"><div class="sd-row-body"><p class="sd-row-title">Export finished</p></div><button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" data-sd-toggle="feed-detail" aria-controls="feed-detail" aria-expanded="false">Details</button></article>
    <div class="sd-expand" id="feed-detail"><div><p class="sd-note">The export is ready to download.</p></div></div>
    <article class="sd-row" data-id="activity-1" data-order="1"><div class="sd-row-body"><p class="sd-row-title">Sync started</p></div></article>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
import { mountFeed, hotkeys } from "signal-design/js";
const root = document.getElementById("demo-feed");
root.addEventListener("sd:feed", ({ detail }) => {
  document.getElementById("feed-above").textContent = `${detail.aboveCount} above`;
});
const feed = mountFeed(root);
const off = hotkeys({ j: () => feed.move(1), k: () => feed.move(-1),
  "g t": () => feed.newest(), n: () => feed.oldest() },
  { target: root, sequenceTimeout: 900, enabled: () => !root.hidden });
document.getElementById("feed-oldest").onclick = () => feed.oldest();
document.getElementById("feed-newest").onclick = () => feed.newest();
let order = 3;
document.getElementById("feed-insert").onclick = () => {
  feed.beforeUpdate();
  const row = document.createElement("article");
  row.className = "sd-row";
  row.dataset.id = `activity-${++order}`;
  row.dataset.order = String(order);
  row.textContent = `Activity ${order} received`;
  root.prepend(row);
  feed.afterUpdate();
};
```

## JS / Setup and attributes



Classes: sd-actions, sd-btn, sd-btn-ghost, sd-btn-sm, sd-code, sd-code-head, sd-subtle, sd-table, sd-table-wrap

JS: init() from signal-design/js wires data-sd-copy · data-sd-open · data-sd-close · data-sd-toggle · data-sd-seg · data-sd-key · data-sd-tip · data-sd-toast · data-sd-theme · data-sd-theme-cycle · popovertarget (placement, menu keys) · role="tab".

```html
<div class="sd-code">
        <div class="sd-code-head">main.js <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm sd-btn-ghost" data-sd-copy="#snippet-js">Copy</button></div>
        <pre id="snippet-js" tabindex="0"><code>import { init, toast, hotkeys, setTheme } from "signal-design/js";

init();                                   // dialogs, popovers, menus, tabs, tooltips, toggles
toast("Saved", { tone: "success" });
const off = hotkeys({ j: next, k: prev, "shift+n": newest, "mod+k": search });
setTheme("paper");                        // ink | graphite | paper | auto</code></pre>
      </div>

<div class="sd-table-wrap">
  <table class="sd-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Attribute</th><th>Does</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><code>data-sd-open="id"</code> · <code>data-sd-close</code></td><td>Opens a dialog as modal; closes the nearest dialog. Backdrop click closes unless <code>data-sd-static</code>.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>popovertarget</code> + <code>.sd-popover</code></td><td>Places the popover next to its trigger, flips at edges, keyboard for menus.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>role="tab"</code></td><td>Selects tabs and panels, arrow keys, roving focus.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>data-sd-toggle="id"</code></td><td>Opens and closes an <code>.sd-expand</code>, keeps <code>aria-expanded</code> in sync.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>data-sd-seg</code></td><td>Single-select button group; fires <code>change</code>.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>data-sd-key="a"</code></td><td>Clicks the element when the key is pressed (ignored while typing).</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>data-sd-tip="text"</code></td><td>Tooltip on hover and focus.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>data-sd-copy="#id"</code></td><td>Copies text, or explains that copying is unavailable.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>data-sd-toast="text"</code></td><td>Shows a toast on click.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>data-sd-theme="paper"</code></td><td>Switches theme and remembers it.</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>

<div class="sd-actions">
  <span class="sd-subtle text-sm">Try:</span>
  <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" data-sd-key="]" data-sd-open="demo-sheet">Sheet <kbd>]</kbd></button>
  <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-sm" data-sd-key="shift+t" data-sd-theme-cycle="">Next theme <kbd>Shift+T</kbd></button>
</div>
```
